title: Qualify managed numerical provider via real-package matrix, statistics and quadrature smoke
commitMessage: docs: qualify managed Math.NET numerical provider candidate

contribution.summary: Qualify the M3-W01-C01 provider-selection spike in one substantial run covering both accepted tasks: exact Math.NET Numerics 5.0.0 NuGet-only managed runtime smoke, independent matrix solve/residual, variance and integration oracles, a relevant Meta.Numerics 4.2.0 metadata comparison, restored dependency and MIT license/hash observations, and explicit native BLAS/RID/thread/cancellation deferrals. Regress Math M2 and satisfy EXT-NUMERIC only on durable evidence.
contribution.value: Establish one executable and license-checked numerical backend candidate for future provider-neutral matrix/statistics work without embedding third-party types in the Math core or claiming AURA/native adoption.
debtChanges: Math.NET 5.0.0 is the provisional managed candidate, not a public Math adapter; M3-W01-C02 and M3-W02-C01 remain planned.
Meta.Numerics 4.2.0 MS-PL is metadata-compared only; no alternative runtime smoke or performance ranking is claimed.
Only the executing OS/RID and 32 independent managed solves are observed; no blanket thread safety, native BLAS, CUDA or unexecuted-platform claims.
Third-party numerical kernels have no qualified cancellation or exact rational semantics; no implicit rational-to-binary64 widening is authorized.
EXT-NUMERIC is satisfied only if the actual MIT package, exact version, SHA-256, dependency graph, numerical smoke and boundary evidence are verified.
contribution.nextAction: After RS039 success, prepare M3-W01-C02-T1 as a substantive independent RED/GREEN numerical matrix and vector contract with bounded shapes, explicit approximation and zero provider-type leakage.

achievements.achievement: Select exact managed Math.NET and MS-PL Meta.Numerics candidate versions and document numerical, licensing and package acceptance criteria.
Run the real managed Math.NET package and record independent solve/statistics/quadrature oracles plus package hash, license, transitive graph and host RID.
Record evidence-bound candidate selection and a reasoned deferred alternative; keep provider types out of Math public APIs.

Managed Math.NET Numerics 5.0.0 selected only after real NuGet smoke of matrix solve/residual, population/sample variance and Gauss-Legendre quadrature and exact package/graph/license checks; Meta.Numerics 4.2.0 is compared at metadata level only.
Fix native BLAS, RID, threading, cancellation, and precision limitations as separate explicit admission criteria.
Observe forced managed backend and 32 independent parallel solves on the actual host while declining unexecuted OS/RID/native claims.
Decide managed-only scope, defer native integration, and qualify EXT-NUMERIC only with the two evidence receipts.
Managed backend is forced on the executing RID; independent parallel solves are observed without blanket thread-safety, cancellation, native BLAS or cross-platform capability claims.

Both numerical-provider spike tasks are completed by real managed Math.NET package/solver/statistics/integration evidence and explicit native/platform boundaries, without adding a numerical provider to public Math packages.
